nodes.label: Bootstrap Baseline Version Tag (v2.2.1)
nodes.rationale: Creates a v2.2.1 tag at the initial commit on the first run so that semantic-release treats all v3.0.0 commits as new. Subsequent runs skip this step because a version tag will already exist.

nodes.label: Program Icon Black
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon depicting a rectangle card with 'PRG' text label — represents a Program entity in dark (#333333) color for use on light backgrounds

nodes.label: Program Icon White
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon depicting a rectangle card with 'PRG' text label — represents a Program entity in white color for use on dark backgrounds

nodes.label: Share Icon Black
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing three connected nodes in a network/fork shape — represents share or social sharing action in dark (#333333) color

nodes.label: Share Icon White
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing three connected nodes in a network/fork shape — represents share or social sharing action in white color for dark backgrounds

nodes.label: Sub-Level Arrow Icon Black
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon depicting an L-shaped arrow pointing right then down from a corner — represents hierarchical sub-level navigation or indented child item in dark (#333333) color

nodes.label: Sub-Level Arrow Icon White
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon depicting an L-shaped arrow pointing right then down from a corner — represents hierarchical sub-level navigation or indented child item in white color

nodes.label: Survey Icon Black
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing a 2x2 grid of squares with the bottom-right square containing a plus sign — represents a survey/form with add item capability, rendered in white fill (intended for dark backgrounds despite filename suffix)

nodes.label: Survey Icon White
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing a 2x2 grid of squares with the bottom-right square containing a plus sign — represents a survey/form with add item capability in white color

nodes.label: Upload Icon (Default)
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing an upward arrow inside a circular arc — represents an upload or publish action; rendered in blue (#2E6692) as the default/inactive state

nodes.label: Upload Icon (Active State)
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing an upward arrow inside a circular arc — represents an upload or publish action; rendered in orange (#F18A1F) as the active/in-progress state

nodes.label: Warning Icon
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing a triangle outline with an exclamation mark inside — represents a warning, alert, or validation error; rendered in amber/yellow (#F19F00) with white stroke

nodes.label: HNQIS Logo
nodes.description: 47x47 brand logo for HNQIS (Health Network Quality Improvement System) — four colored quadrant sections: top-left orange PRG label, top-right yellow puzzle/checklist shape, bottom-left green bar chart, bottom-right blue line graph with upward trend

nodes.label: More Vertical (Overflow) Icon Black
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing three vertically stacked dots — represents a vertical overflow menu or context menu trigger in dark (#333333) color

nodes.label: More Vertical (Overflow) Icon White
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing three vertically stacked dots — represents a vertical overflow menu or context menu trigger in white color for dark backgrounds

nodes.label: Open External Link Icon
nodes.description: 24x20 UI icon showing a rounded rectangle with an arrow pointing diagonally up-right out of it — represents opening a link or resource in an external window or tab

nodes.label: PATH Organization Logo
nodes.description: 86x33 brand logo for PATH (Program for Appropriate Technology in Health) — 'PATH' wordmark in dark grey with red geometric shapes (circles, diamond, hexagon, triangle) forming a visual icon set to the left

nodes.label: Scores Icon
nodes.description: 24x24 UI icon showing two overlapping circles with a diagonal dividing line — represents a scores, percentage, or ratio concept; visually similar to a percentage/fraction symbol

nodes.label: Graphic E-1
nodes.description: Abstract geometric graphic featuring a large pink triangle on the left, a grid of black-and-white triangles in the center, and alternating green and yellow vertical stripes on the right. Bold, flat colors with a modern design aesthetic.

nodes.label: Graphic E-2
nodes.description: Abstract geometric graphic composed of a checkerboard pattern in yellow and white, an orange-and-blue horizontal stripe block, and an orange triangle on the left. Uses the same bold flat color palette as the rest of the Graphic E series.

nodes.label: Graphic E-3
nodes.description: Abstract geometric graphic with a teal checkerboard block on the left, a cluster of black-and-white triangles in the lower center, and alternating yellow-and-white vertical stripes on the right, on a white background. Consistent with the Graphic E series visual language.

nodes.label: Graphic E-4
nodes.description: Abstract geometric graphic nearly identical to Graphic E-3, featuring a teal checkerboard block on the left, black-and-white triangles in the lower center, and yellow-and-white vertical stripes on the right. Likely a variant or alternate version of E-3 within the same design series.
